change: Default persistent-cache loaded-executable hash uses serial BLAKE3 instead of SHA-256. Both read actual opened image bytes; explicit SHA retains its v4 domain, BLAKE3 retains v5. Execution/compiler evidence remains full SHA-256.
architecture_review: Astra xhigh reviewed source, protocol, feature isolation, rejected outcome and accepted follow-up.

post_measurement_documentation.meaning: Documentation completed after both audits; all six non-README source-event inputs remain unchanged. No production source or frozen executable changed after measurement.

protocol.change: Default serial full loaded-executable cache image hash: SHA-256 to existing BLAKE3. Outer domain-separated cache keys and separate execution SHA-256 evidence stay intact.
protocol.corpus_authority: All sources, source hashes and exact stdout are unchanged from target/performance-standalone-pool/source-corpus-proposal.json, 19 runtime-free and 18 heap-backed sources.
protocol.cold: Fresh actual CLI process, fresh private empty disk cache each invocation.
protocol.warm: Fresh actual CLI process, separate private product/case/block cache, one recorded priming process then four timed processes. Native and P caches are warm; OS page cache is uncontrolled.
protocol.boundary: Parent before GNU-time supervisor launch to child/supervisor process exit, includes source read, compile/cache, requested artifact writes, execution and teardown. No result-marker subtraction; no fsync claim.
protocol.accounting: CPU is user+system summed per process before mean or median; GNU-time child lifetime RSS excludes Python launcher; wall and CPU independent.

acceptance.primary: Cold and warm each need geometric mean ratios of per-case process medians <=0.90 for wall AND CPU in BOTH blocks.
acceptance.timing_veto: For any individual case/mode including build controls, wall OR CPU median AND mean ratio >=1.03 in BOTH blocks vetoes landing.
acceptance.rss_veto: For any individual case/mode, absolute peak RSS median AND mean rise >=4 MiB in BOTH blocks vetoes landing.
acceptance.artifact: All 37 unchanged sources must emit byte-identical P and raw R across products. Both complete standard/portable native R images and raw Wasm profiles must remain identical.
acceptance.correctness: Exact raw stdout in every run, successful bounded exits, real opened-image native identity tests, explicit SHA and BLAKE3 correctness, true default/explicit warm program-cache hits in separate unscored trace processes.
acceptance.a_a: Descriptive identical-binary calibration, all samples and repeated-veto diagnostics reported without rerun or truncation. This distinct cold-process hill does not waive prior failed hot primitive-append A/A.
acceptance.build_controls: No improvement target. These paths should not request executable cache identity; retain all timing and RSS observations.

protocol.evidence: Freeze executable SHA, embedded source identity, source event/patch, Cargo producer logs, runtime products, wrapper/harness/tools/corpus and exact receipts. Recheck input snapshots after each stage. No heavy work overlaps scored processes. Failed attempts and all observations retained.
protocol.correction: Original mixed bin+example product failed RSS veto and remains rejected. Rebuild ordinary CLI alone to remove dev-dependency feature contamination; no product source change or gate change.

reuse.a_a: Reuse unchanged original 224 timed +24 prime A/A; same frozen baseline, sources, accounting, limits, orders, and reduction. No repeated calibration.
reuse.native: Reuse original 70 selected Engine tests; exact unchanged source event and actual native test binary retained. Ordinary CLI target features must match those Engine tests.
reuse.example: Reuse frozen mixed-feature diagnostic runtime_boundaries solely to observe admitted algorithm; it is never a scored product.

protocol.feature_contract: Ordinary target Wasmtime/Rustix feature sets must equal baseline, including separation from runtime-image host build features; reject async/component-model contamination.

calibration.reuse: Original identical-binary A/A retained with unchanged relevant inputs; no rerun.

rejected_result.reason: Mixed --bin/--example Cargo invocation admitted dev-dependency target features. Its original RSS veto is preserved; its timings are not accepted ordinary-product results.
rejected_result.diagnosis: Separate 64-process same-binary/SHA/BLAKE3 factorial is descriptive; feature inequality alone is not quantitative RSS attribution.

native_reuse.reason: The CLI-only rebuild has the same source event and scriptw-engine Cargo features as the already completed Engine test build; no Engine production source changed.

native_dependency_reuse.reason: Actual opt3 Wasmtime and Rustix target dependency source, features and profiles match the previously passing Engine library-test build; these are separate from opt1 runtime-image host roles.
